training.selectionRule: highest oracle pass rate per family; tie-break lowest total tokens, then alphabetical

revealSpec: La contrainte de phase 2 est contenue dans le prompt ; le moment de revelation est la frontiere entre le diagnostic initial et la synthese finale, identique pour les trois conditions.

conditions.note: GenOS peut choisir et appliquer une transition (reorganisation admise).
Meme runtime, topologie figee par famille selectionnee sur les 6 taches d'entrainement, sans adaptation.
Meme runtime, transition inadaptee imposee par tache (task.wrongTopology), admissible mais inadaptee.

successCriterion.primary: adaptive oracle pass rate exceeds both controls on paired holdout tasks
successCriterion.statistics: paired difference with 95% Wald interval fully positive plus McNemar test
successCriterion.budget: no attempt exceeds the shared token/latency ceiling
successCriterion.attestation: adaptive attempts must carry a verified morph transitionId with bound workers and sealed receipt; a verified transition without gain proves the mechanism, not its utility

limitations: Single repetition per task-condition pair: pilot-grade evidence, not confirmatory (suite requires 3).
The phase-2 constraint is informational within one prompt; the reveal moment is the epoch boundary between initial diagnosis and final synthesis, not an external temporal injection.
Training and holdout share families by design (frozen topology is selected per family); instances, params and oracleIds are disjoint.
oracle-selection arm stays pending: no training outcomes exist outside this protocol.
